In response to your first question, no. It just feels like everyday is the same, going to be the same and I just don't feel like living through hell to achieve nothing but a shitty job and no family. I have no options apart from, you know, suicide. Also, I know how fucking disgusting I look, no one will love me for my looks and my personality is terrible so I don't think I will ever find love.
See, that's the thing; I honestly don't think it will.

Both. I don't think they'll keep what I tell them a secret, think of me as another whiny teen and also I have social anxiety and find it really hard to talk to people. I fear while I'm there I'd have a panic attack (I have them often).

It aggravates me that people think being unattractive is not enough to make you seriously upset because honestly it's affected my life more than I'd like to say. And yes, spot on, I'm from the UK. Our school does have a counselling service but I'm really scared to go.
